card.title: Profile card
card.text: A summary for your GitHub profile README. The Action redraws it every day in every theme. The snippet shows the dark card to readers in dark mode and the light one to everyone else.

badges.title: Badges
badges.text: Static SVG images, regenerated on a schedule by the GitHub Action in this repository. Paste the Markdown into your GitHub profile README.

settings.token: API token (optional, stays in this browser)
settings.tokenRequired: API token (required, stays in this browser)
settings.note: Without a token each Weblate instance allows about 100 requests per day, which is enough for a daily refresh of a few dozen components. Settings saved here apply to this browser only, and tokens never leave it. To make the settings permanent, copy the config and commit it as tallyglot.config.json.

stats.title: {{language}} in numbers
stats.intro: Recorded once a day by the GitHub Action. Activity comes from your Weblate change history; other platforms do not publish it.
stats.calendarEmpty: No activity has been recorded yet. The calendar fills in after the next run of the GitHub Action, which reads your change history from Weblate.

chart.title: Completion over time
chart.empty: No history for this period yet. The Action adds one point per day.
chart.single: One day recorded so far. The line grows by a point every day.
chart.label: {{name}}: from {{from}}% to {{to}}% translated
chart.keys: Completion chart. Use the left and right arrow keys to read each day.

stats.milestonesEmpty: Nothing yet. Milestones appear as projects reach 100% and contributions add up.

find.title: Find work in {{language}}
find.intro: Open-source projects on your platforms that have little or no {{language}} yet, most popular first. Pick one and start where you are needed most.
find.none: No projects match. Loosen the filters, or scan more of the platform.
find.indexText: The GitHub Action reads a few more projects every day, within each platform's request limits. An API token makes it ten times faster.
find.scanNone: Nothing new could be read right now
find.unsupported: Not searchable: {{platforms}}. Their APIs have no public project directory. Projects you list in the config still appear on the dashboard.
find.emptyText: The list is built by the scheduled GitHub Action. It appears after the next run. On platforms that allow browser requests you can start right now.

team.intro: Every project the team translates into {{language}}, who has been active, and what is closest to done. Share this page with the team.
team.activeHint: Members with a contribution in the last 30 days
team.boardEmpty: No contributions in this period. Activity is read from Weblate once a day by the GitHub Action.

setup.title: Set up your own Tallyglot
setup.intro: Answer a few questions, copy the result, and follow a few steps on GitHub. No terminal, no editing files by hand. Nothing you type here leaves your browser.
setup.languageHint: As the platform writes it in addresses: sq, pt_BR, zh_Hans.
setup.displayNameHint: Shown on the profile card and the portfolio.
setup.usernamesHint: Weblate finds your projects from your username. Separate several with commas.
setup.needsToken: (needs an API token, added as a secret in step 5)
setup.teamHint: Fill this in to track a whole language team: list every member under usernames.
setup.alerts: Alerts when a project adds new strings
setup.alertsText: Checked once a day by the GitHub Action.
setup.digest: One summary a day instead of a message per project
setup.try: Try it in this browser now

problem.languageShape: The language code looks unusual. Codes look like sq, pt_BR or zh_Hans.
problem.username: Enter your Weblate username, so your projects can be found.

setup.publishText: Tick each step as you go. Your progress is remembered in this browser.
setup.needUser: Enter your GitHub username above to get the link.

step.forkText: This gives you your own copy. Keep the name, or note the one you choose.
step.configText: Open the config file in your fork, select everything in it, paste what you copied in step 4, and press “Commit changes”.
step.secretsTokens: Create a secret named TALLYGLOT_TOKENS holding your API tokens as JSON, for example {"crowdin":"…"}.
step.secretsWebhook: Create a secret named ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL holding the Discord or Slack webhook address.
step.pagesText: Under “Build and deployment”, choose “Deploy from a branch”, branch main, folder / (root), then Save.
step.actionsText: If asked, press “I understand my workflows, go ahead and enable them”. Then choose “Run workflow”. The first run takes about a minute.
step.openText: It is live a minute or two after the workflow finishes.

glossary.title: Glossary and consistency
glossary.intro: Short strings you have translated, grouped by term. A term with more than one translation across your projects is flagged, so you can settle on one and fix the rest.
glossary.allConsistent: Every term is translated the same way everywhere. Nothing to fix.
glossary.exportText: Download the glossary and import it into a Weblate glossary component (Files → Upload translation), or any tool that reads TBX. Each term is exported with your preferred translation, or its only one, or its most used one.
glossary.strict: Leave out terms I have not decided on
glossary.nothingToExport: There are no terms to export yet.
glossary.emptyText: The glossary is built once a day by the GitHub Action from your Weblate change history. It appears after the next run. Other platforms do not publish individual translations, so they are not included.

review.title: Review queue
review.intro: Everything that needs your attention, across every platform: failing quality checks, suggestions waiting for a decision, strings marked for editing, and comments.
review.clear: Nothing is waiting. The queue is empty.
review.noneNow: Nothing is listed any more. It may have been dealt with since the last refresh.

error.limit: The platform's request limit is used up. The link above still opens the list in the editor. An API token in Settings lifts the limit.
error.network: {{name}} does not allow this page to read its strings. The link above opens the list in the editor.

review.newStringsEmpty: No project has added strings since alerts were turned on.
review.tokens: Listing strings uses one request per list. Platforms that need a token, or that ran out of anonymous requests, read it from {{settings}}; tokens are kept in this browser only and never committed.

maintainer.title: For maintainers
maintainer.intro: See how your project is translated: coverage in every language, who has been active, and which languages have gone quiet. The address of this page can be shared as it is.
maintainer.formHint: For Weblate, enter hosted, codeberg, fedora, or the address of any other instance. Crowdin, Transifex and Lokalise need an API token; it is used for this request only.
maintainer.staleHint: Unfinished, with no change for 90 days or more
maintainer.staleUnknown: This platform does not report when a language last changed
maintainer.noLanguages: This project has no translations yet.
maintainer.translatorsNote: From the project's most recent translation changes.
maintainer.translatorsUnknown: {{platform}} does not publish who translated what.
maintainer.readmeLive: These images are redrawn every day by the GitHub Action of this site. The chart follows the reader's light or dark mode.
maintainer.readmeSetup: To get a chart and badge that update themselves, add the project to the configuration of your own Tallyglot. The daily GitHub Action then draws them into the maintainer folder. The configuration needs nothing else.

error.instance: Enter hosted, codeberg, fedora, or the address of a Weblate instance.

error.actionOnly: {{name}} cannot be read from a browser. Add the project under “maintainer” in a Tallyglot configuration, and the GitHub Action will read it instead.
error.token: {{name}} answers only with an API token. Enter one above; it is not stored.
